profile.description: Operational Neoverse-V2/KleidiAI product lane with explicit Arm decoder policy.

quality_gate.audio_gate: existing per-ISA audio/WER/SIM/ear gate on the fixed bank

parity.notes: KleidiAI is the generic Talker/CP/Q4 backend. The speech decoder remains per-item Arm DOTPROD; it is not an AMX Design-D equivalent.

hardware.cpu_family: host-specific Neoverse-V2/i8mm; measured topology must be supplied by the campaign
hardware.notes: KAI HWCAP and i8mm/BF16 support must be proven by preflight.

precision.activations: KAI native preparation; INT8 decoder panels

QWEN_ARM_BFDOT.why: keep the measured/default KAI BF16 policy explicit; BFDOT is a separate opt-in

OPENBLAS_THREAD_TIMEOUT.why: keep the external BLAS pool from spinning against the engine pool

OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS.why: must be absent so engine-owned BLAS sizing is effective

OMP_NUM_THREADS.why: must be absent; the engine profile owns the CPU budget

QWEN_CP_PREFILL2.why: pin the explicit Arm CP prefill policy

QWEN_DECODER_BATCH.why: keep server batching semantics; preflight verifies per-item decoder leaf

QWEN_INT8_SDOT_MM.why: do not opt into the separate generic SDOT matmat gate

QWEN_INT8_SDOT_MIN_B.why: pin the Arm SDOT matmat gate even though the product decoder is per-item

QWEN_BFMMLA_MIN_B.why: pin the Arm BF16 matrix gate

QWEN_KAI_LHS.why: pin the existing asymmetric KAI LHS quantisation mode

QWEN_KAI_NCHUNK.why: pin the measured KAI GEMM n-subtiling policy

QWEN_NO_BFMMLA.why: allow native Arm BF16 matrix path

QWEN_NO_KLEIDI.why: KleidiAI is the Arm product backend

QWEN_NO_Q8REPACK.why: retain the native Arm Q8 repack path

QWEN_NO_SDOT.why: require the Arm DOTPROD decoder leaf

QWEN_POOL_SPIN.why: Arm-specific starting policy; must be requalified on the target host

QWEN_PREFIX_CACHE.why: same server semantics as the AMX lane

QWEN_SD_AMX.why: x86-only legacy switch; must be absent on Arm

QWEN_SD_INT8.why: explicitly opt into the Arm DOTPROD decoder for qualification

QWEN_SD_INT8_BLK.why: pin the existing non-VNNI decoder block policy

QWEN_SD_RAG_MIN_PANELS.why: same logical threshold; no Arm ragged decoder implementation is implied

QWEN_SD_STREAM_STRIP.why: Design-D warm strip unavailable on Arm

QWEN_SD_WINDOWED.why: explicitly disable the legacy windowed fallback so the exact streaming decoder semantics are resolved

QWEN_SERVER_NO_DECODER_BATCH.why: presence flag must remain absent; decoder request is explicit

qualification.workload: Operational lane contract; no new hardware result is claimed by this file.
qualification.notes: A clean KAI/HWCAP preflight and the per-ISA quality gate are mandatory before performance data.
